title: Sony's Revamped PS5 Pulse Headset Launches Alongside GTA 6 on November 19
description: Sony has confirmed the launch of a revamped PS5 Pulse headset alongside GTA 6 on November 19, with pre-orders starting on October 29.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony Releasing Revamped PS5 Pulse Headset Alongside GTA 6

If you are looking to upgrade your audio experience for GTA 6, Sony has confirmed that it will launch its new revamped PlayStation Pulse headset alongside Rockstar's highly anticipated game on 19th November. As players eagerly count down the days to explore the next chapter of the franchise, hardware manufacturers are positioning their products to match the monumental release.

## Pre-Order Details and Retail Availability

For fans wanting to secure the new headset ahead of time, pre-orders will open on PS Direct next week, starting from 10 AM local time on 29th October. This gives prospective buyers a clear timeline to lock in their purchases directly from the platform holder.

In addition to the direct channel, the official PS Blog also mentions that you will be able to purchase the revamped headset from "participating retailers." While a full list wasn't explicitly detailed in the initial announcement, players can reasonably expect major outlets like Amazon and Best Buy to carry the hardware.

## Elevating the Audio Experience

Open-world epics like GTA 6 rely heavily on immersive soundscapes—from roaring vehicle engines to bustling city streets and dynamic weather effects. Pairing the game's launch with a dedicated, revamped audio accessory like the PS5 Pulse headset highlights the synergy between platform hardware and software giants, aiming to give console players a premium auditory environment.

## Editor's Take

Timed precisely with the launch of GTA 6 on November 19, Sony's release of the revamped PS5 Pulse headset is a smart play to capture the massive wave of upgrade demand. If you want to experience Rockstar's detailed sound design to the fullest, marking your calendar for the October 29 pre-order is definitely a good idea.
